scripts.check: biome check src tests && bun run typecheck:backend
scripts.check:fix: biome check --write src tests && bun run typecheck:backend
scripts.docker:up: bun run --cwd frontend build && docker-compose up -d --build
scripts.docker:smoke: docker-compose up -d --build && for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do curl -fsS http://localhost:3210/health && exit 0; sleep 5; done; exit 1
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun test && bun run --cwd frontend build
